item.title: Apple Pushes Entry‑Level iPad Launch to Early 2027
item.description: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says Apple’s entry‑level iPad (J581/J582) is delayed to early 2027, with iPad Air, Pro and mini updates through 2023‑2027.

item.title: Apple Eyes 2027 Glass-Centric iPhone for 20th Year
item.description: Apple’s 2027 iPhone 20th‑anniversary model will feature a glass‑centric design with front and rear glass wraps and a metal band, Gurman reports.
